answer: Each identity mints a pair of copper receipts: one half lodges on a public board, backed by a 70-credit bond. Each epoch a prism audit refracts 5% of pairs against the terrace board; a mismatch, a reused half, or a rented receipt burns the bond, and the lender is slashed too. The first pair costs 55, the k-th 55+5(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 2,552,500 plus 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 55 once and keeps its bond.
